audit_metadata.skip_reason: Backend and frontend services not running — static-only audit

escalations.title: Handlebars.js JavaScript Injection
escalations.description: Multiple JavaScript injection vectors in template compilation and rendering. Arbitrary code execution if user input reaches template processing.

escalations.title: Vitest UI Arbitrary File Read & Execution
escalations.description: Unauthenticated Vitest UI server allows arbitrary file read and code execution from the network. Critical if dev server is exposed in CI or shared environments.
escalations.notes: Dev-only but affects CI if ports are exposed

escalations.title: Protobufjs Arbitrary Code Execution
escalations.description: Arbitrary code injection during protobuf deserialization. RCE in gRPC message processing if untrusted schemas or messages are processed.

p2_backlog.title: Traceability gate produces false green on default invocation
p2_backlog.description: Default enforcer command selects only the most-recently-modified requirements.md (self-judging-workflow), passes, and hides 7 failing portal/ plans with 136 missing FRs.
p2_backlog.recommendation: Add wrapper script that runs enforcer against all plans; update CLAUDE.md verification gate.

p2_backlog.title: GET /api/search route missing from Source/Backend
p2_backlog.description: FR-dependency-search requires search endpoint. Test file exists and self-documents as failing. Route exists in portal/Backend but not Source/Backend.
p2_backlog.recommendation: Create Source/Backend/src/routes/search.ts and wire into app.ts.

p2_backlog.title: 3 open items from dependency-linking plan delta
p2_backlog.description: FR-dependency-api-types (blocked_by field missing), FR-dependency-seed (seed.ts absent), FR-dependency-frontend-tests (DependencySection + BlockedBadge test files missing).

p2_backlog.title: Vite Server Filesystem Restriction Bypass
p2_backlog.description: Path traversal bypasses server.fs.deny on Windows via UNC paths.

p2_backlog.title: ws Memory Exhaustion DoS
p2_backlog.description: WebSocket library susceptible to memory exhaustion via malformed tiny fragments.

p2_backlog.title: form-data CRLF Injection
p2_backlog.description: Multipart form field names unescaped — CRLF injection enables HTTP header manipulation.

p2_backlog.title: @grpc/grpc-js Server Crash on Malformed Messages
p2_backlog.description: Malformed or compressed gRPC messages crash the server. Remote unauthenticated DoS.

p2_backlog.title: path-to-regexp ReDoS in Route Matching
p2_backlog.description: RegExp denial of service via crafted URLs causing exponential backtracking in route matching.

p2_backlog.title: picomatch ReDoS & Method Injection
p2_backlog.description: Glob pattern matching vulnerable to ReDoS via extglob quantifiers and method injection via POSIX character classes.

p2_backlog.title: OpenTelemetry Prometheus Exporter Crash on Malformed Requests
p2_backlog.description: Prometheus metrics endpoint crashes when receiving malformed HTTP requests (e.g., missing Content-Length).

p3_backlog.title: OpenTelemetry tracing absent from Source/Backend
p3_backlog.description: CLAUDE.md mandates OTel distributed tracing. FR-WF-013 comments claim compliance but zero @opentelemetry imports exist in Source/Backend.
p3_backlog.recommendation: Add @opentelemetry/sdk-node + auto-instrumentations; initialize before routes; add traceparent middleware.

p3_backlog.title: Duplicate frontend test files inflating test count
p3_backlog.description: Older top-level test files and newer pages/ subdirectory tests both run, doubling runtime and creating silent redundancy.
p3_backlog.recommendation: Remove older top-level versions; pages/ variants are more comprehensive.

p3_backlog.title: Traceability enforcer regex extracts false FR IDs from prose
p3_backlog.description: Regex FR-[A-Z0-9-]+ matches example data IDs and spec-reference ranges, not just requirement table rows. Inflates missing count by 7 for dependency-linking plan.
p3_backlog.recommendation: Scope extraction to table rows only: r"\|\s*(FR-[A-Z0-9-]+)\s*\|"

p3_backlog.title: portal/ code outside traceability enforcer scope
p3_backlog.description: portal/ contains primary product app with 937+ Verifies: comments but enforcer only scans Source/ and E2E/. Portal traceability completely unverified.
p3_backlog.recommendation: Add portal/ to source.dirs in inspector.config.yml.

p3_backlog.title: uuid Buffer Bounds Check Missing
p3_backlog.fix: npm update uuid@^14.0.1 (major version — test thoroughly)

p3_backlog.title: esbuild CORS Bypass in Dev Server
p3_backlog.description: Dev server allows any website to send requests and read responses (CORS bypass). Dev-only risk.

p3_backlog.title: js-yaml DoS via Merge Key Aliases

p4_backlog.title: Two eslint-disable suppressions without explanatory comments
p4_backlog.description: Both suppress react-hooks/exhaustive-deps. Intentional but undocumented technical debt.
p4_backlog.recommendation: Add inline comments explaining why the full dep array would cause incorrect behavior.

cross_reference_map.root_cause: Vite/esbuild dev toolchain below secure version
cross_reference_map.single_fix: npm update vite@^8.1.5 across Source/Frontend and portal/Frontend
cross_reference_map.fix_impact: Resolves both DEP-004 (path traversal) and DEP-013 (CORS bypass)

cross_reference_map.root_cause: Traceability enforcer scope gap — portal/ excluded
cross_reference_map.single_fix: Add portal/ to inspector.config.yml source.dirs + update CLAUDE.md gate command
cross_reference_map.fix_impact: Resolves both QO-001 (false green) and QO-007 (portal/ unverified) simultaneously

cross_reference_map.root_cause: OpenTelemetry library chain not updated across monorepo
cross_reference_map.single_fix: Add @opentelemetry/sdk-node to Source/Backend AND update @opentelemetry/sdk-node@^0.220.0 in portal/Backend
cross_reference_map.fix_impact: Resolves QO-004 (missing tracing), DEP-017 (Prometheus crash), DEP-018 (baggage DoS) — three findings, one coordinated upgrade sprint
